text: The initiative is part of a global effort to advance risk-transfer and risk-financing solutions to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It emphasizes expanding distribution channels, building public-sector capacity, and leveraging existing government-subsidized agriculture insurance. The diagnostic provides a roadmap for scaling inclusive insurance and DRF, aligning with Nepal’s national disaster risk strategy and broader climate and development agendas.
